scope.summary: Add a structural Git merge driver for Cargo.lock that merges disjoint [[package]] additions and refuses same-package version divergence or removal-vs-edit conflicts.
explicit_non_claims: No generated JSON face is hand-edited.
No production CI authority, branch protection setting, or external infrastructure is changed.
Cargo.lock is changed only through cargo metadata after adding the new workspace member.
The driver is a local Git merge driver; developers or CI images must configure merge.cargo-lock.driver before Git invokes it.

facets.F1_correctness: The merge engine parses Cargo.lock package blocks structurally, keys packages by name/version/source, preserves the lockfile preamble, allows disjoint additions, and returns conflict exit semantics for version divergence or removal-vs-edit cases.
facets.F2_tests: TDD RED was observed through a Buck2 compile failure for missing merge_lockfiles/MergeErrorKind, then GREEN through five required fixtures: disjoint-add, version-divergence conflict, removal-vs-edit conflict, idempotence, and header preservation.
facets.F3_maintainability: The app is isolated to one small tool crate with a pure library surface, a thin CLI, a BUCK target, and operator activation docs.
facets.F4_compatibility: The .gitattributes change only affects Cargo.lock and leaves the existing evidence/audit-chain.jsonl union driver unchanged.
facets.F5_security: No credentials, network calls, dynamic code loading, or unsafe Rust are introduced; production code carries #![forbid(unsafe_code)].
facets.F6_privacy: No tenant, user, or personal data processing changes.
facets.F7_operability: README documents the Git config command; the CLI writes %A on success and exits 1 on semantic conflicts for normal Git merge-driver behavior.
facets.F8_performance: The driver operates over Cargo.lock text in memory and uses package-block maps; no repo-wide scan or external process is needed during a merge.
facets.F9_compliance: Records multispectrum evidence and audit-chain linkage; respects generated-face policy and uses Cargo metadata for Cargo.lock refresh.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal revert of one additive tool crate, one workspace member row, one generated lock package entry, and one .gitattributes entry.
facets.F11_observability: Local evidence records RED/GREEN test output, affected Buck2 build/test results, diff hygiene, and source forbidden-call scan.
facets.F13_migration: Reduces Cargo.lock merge-storm risk while keeping Cargo.lock as the single generated dependency lockfile for the root workspace.
